note: Printable flyers listed on flyers.html. Each flyer's print source is flyers/src/<id>.html; run `node scripts/build_flyers.cjs` to rebuild the PDFs and preview images after editing a source.

flyers.title: Veteran Resource Guide flyer
flyers.use: For a bulletin board or front desk: VA clinics, county veterans offices, senior centers, nursing homes, libraries, churches and veteran posts.
flyers.alt: Yellow flyer headed "Find veteran help near you" with a QR code to guide.vethomeguard.org, crisis numbers and ten kinds of help in the guide.

flyers.title: Family Guide flyer
flyers.use: For a bulletin board: pediatric and therapy waiting rooms, schools, libraries, churches and community centers.
flyers.alt: Flyer headed "Worried about your child?" with two age choices, Ohio phone numbers, a QR code to the Family Guide and the 988 crisis line.

flyers.title: Family Guide handout
flyers.use: To hand to a parent or leave at a front desk. The two-per-page version prints on regular letter paper; cut it in half.
flyers.alt: Half-sheet handout headed "Worried about your child?" with two age choices, Ohio phone numbers, a QR code to the Family Guide and the 988 crisis line.

flyers.title: VA pension and Aid and Attendance sheet
flyers.guide_name: VA pension and Aid and Attendance
flyers.use: For a nursing home social work office, a family meeting or a veterans post: who may qualify, how care costs count, the $90 Medicaid rule and how to avoid pension scams.
flyers.alt: One-page sheet headed "VA pension with Aid and Attendance" with eligibility, current limits, the $90 Medicaid rule, a warning about paid advisors and phone numbers.

flyers.title: Abuse, neglect and exploitation sheet
flyers.use: For a nursing home, senior center or family: what to report, where to call, and how to report a VA fiduciary misusing benefits.
flyers.alt: One-page sheet headed "Abuse, neglect or money being taken" with what to report, where to call, Ohio Adult Protective Services and VA fiduciary and Inspector General numbers.

flyers.title: Guardianship and alternatives sheet
flyers.use: For families and social workers: powers of attorney, health care agents, supported decision-making, VA fiduciaries and Ohio probate guardianship basics.
flyers.alt: One-page sheet headed "Guardianship and the choices to try first" with planning papers, the VA fiduciary, Ohio guardianship basics and legal help numbers.

flyers.title: Hospice and burial sheet
flyers.use: For hospice teams, funeral homes and families: VA hospice, burial allowances, pre-need eligibility, unclaimed veterans and Ohio veterans cemeteries.
flyers.alt: One-page sheet headed "Hospice and burial for veterans" with VA hospice, burial allowance amounts, pre-need eligibility and Ohio cemetery phone numbers.

flyers.title: Agent Orange and PACT Act sheet
flyers.guide_name: Agent Orange and the PACT Act
flyers.use: For a nursing home admissions or social work office: the Agent Orange conditions and places VA presumes, the PACT Act and the toxic exposure screening.
flyers.alt: One-page sheet headed "Agent Orange and the PACT Act" with presumptive conditions, places, Blue Water Navy, screening and phone numbers.

flyers.title: Bad paper discharge checklist
flyers.use: For a veteran with an other-than-honorable, general or bad-conduct discharge, or the family member helping: a one-page start, which board and form, and free help. Also for veterans service offices, legal aid waiting rooms and VA social workers.
flyers.alt: Yellow checklist headed "Bad paper discharge? Start here." with this week's steps, which board and form to use, the boards for each branch and a QR code to the bad paper guide.
